purpose: Minimal task-local adapter probe after the public wrap_rule private-import failure.
argv:
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from reviewer_support import canonical_pairs, canonical_path, find_root
from puzzle_generators.rule_wrap import strip_rule_wrapper
from arc_repl.racket_bridge import RacketBridge
root = find_root(Path.cwd())
row = next(json.loads(line) for line in canonical_path(root).read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(line).get("task_id") == "1b2b9283b4ab")
source = row["program_solution"]
passed = []
with RacketBridge(timeout=10) as bridge:
    for pair in canonical_pairs("1b2b9283b4ab", root=root):
        literal = "'(" + " ".join("(" + " ".join(map(str, r)) + ")" for r in pair["input"]) + ")"
        actual = bridge.eval_text(f"((lambda (g) {strip_rule_wrapper(source)}) {literal})")
        passed.append(actual == pair["output"])
print(json.dumps({"canonical_rule_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), "canonical_labels_checked": len(passed), "passed": passed, "all_passed": all(passed)}))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(passed) else 1)
